worldcombat.skill.whirlwind.summary: Push a standing wall of wind forward along a chosen direction, carrying every enemy it truly sweeps along the wind and switching out an opponent that has a reserve. No damage; the wind breaks on walls, so stepping out of the lane or letting terrain block it dodges the move.
worldcombat.skill.whirlwind.use.0: Blow a line of enemies away at once
worldcombat.skill.whirlwind.use.1: Shove attackers back out of reach
worldcombat.skill.whirlwind.use.2: Use walls and doorways so only part of the wind passes
Push a wall of wind up to %1$s blocks long with a radius of about %2$s blocks along your aim (half to each side); the standing curtain you see sweeping is exactly what the move covers, and its leading edge follows real walls.
The wall advances at %1$s blocks per tick; enemies it truly sweeps are pushed along the wind for at most %2$s blocks in total, and stop being pushed the moment they leave the wind face.

No damage: the wind breaks on walls, so a target behind a wall is never reached while openings let it through; each enemy is registered only once. A target that resists displacement is not moved, but the wind still sweeps it.

An opponent that is swept and has an available reserve is forced out, and the reserve enters at its landing spot; a wild or reserve-less target is only blown away and then seeks enemies normally again.
worldcombat.skill.whirlwind.wide.on: Wide wall on: the lane radius is x1.35, at the cost of x0.85 lane length and x0.9 blow budget, plus 2 ticks more wind-up and a 15-tick longer cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.whirlwind.wide.off: Wide wall off: a narrower, longer lane with a stronger blow and a shorter wind-up and cooldown, good for clearing at range.
worldcombat.skill.whirlwind.timing: Cast within %1$s blocks; after %2$s seconds of preparation it costs %4$s PP, then %3$s seconds of recovery and a %5$s second cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.whirlwind.growth.0: At level %1$s the lane lengthens to %2$s blocks and the blow budget reaches %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.whirlwind.growth.1: At level %1$s the lane lengthens to %2$s blocks and the blow budget reaches %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.whirlwind.preference.w: On: lane radius x1.35, lane x0.85, blow x0.9, with +2 ticks wind-up and +15 cooldown. Off: narrower, longer and blows farther, with a shorter wind-up and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.whirlwind.preference.a: The companion only considers a whirlwind when an enemy is within this distance; smaller is point-blank, larger opens at range.
Only consider a whirlwind when at least this many enemies are within range; raise it to stay restrained.
When aiming, the companion only counts enemies lined up in a corridor this wide that are also in its line of sight, and picks the busiest line.
On: it will leave its station under a hold order to cast. Off: it only does so when the enemy is already in reach.
world_combat.move.whirlwind.text.blow: The wind wall carried %1$s opponent(s) away
